proposals.risk: a result its requirement or criteria name is computed or chosen wrongly
proposals.rationale: Mapping-form named tool choice yields kind 'raw' with the raw mapping, so the two public named-choice forms (string and mapping) do not normalize to the same named selection; the mapping form is never converted to a 'named' choice.

proposals.risk: a result its requirement or criteria name is computed or chosen wrongly
proposals.rationale: The public "required" choice is normalized to a named choice with name 'required' (or fallback to the first registered tool), so providers request a specific tool rather than any registered tool; a required call without a name is chosen wrongly.

proposals.risk: one input partition its requirement or criteria name is no longer handled as they say
proposals.rationale: Mapping-form named tool choice loses its selected tool name: the name is validated but the returned ToolChoice has name=None, so providers such as Google GenAI cannot restrict to the named tool.

proposals.risk: one input partition its requirement or criteria name is no longer handled as they say
proposals.rationale: The public "required" choice is only normalized to a required call when a registry is supplied; without one it silently degrades to auto, so providers do not ask for a tool call.

proposals.risk: a payload that crosses the interface loses or changes a field its schema requires
proposals.rationale: The mapping form validates the tool name but then builds the ToolChoice without it (name=None), so the selected tool is lost when the mapping crosses to the provider translation layer.

proposals.risk: a payload that crosses the interface loses or changes a field its schema requires
proposals.rationale: When copying the mapping form, the required "type" field of the provider-native payload is dropped from the raw dict, so the payload forwarded to the provider no longer satisfies its schema.
